escalation_path.action: build the replay harness (mapper-only launch, TF re-publisher, service scheduler, recorded karto_in stream) and repeat N0
escalation_path.estimated_cost: multi-day engineering change to the ROS/Stage pipeline
escalation_path.trigger: the matched-pair repeatability proves too coarse to resolve the effect the direction gate needs (MDE larger than the effect)

inputs_already_recorded_by_this_reposito: episode_result.json MoveTo goals and probe ground-truth trajectory
limitations: matched pairs control the seed, the route, the map and the probe, but the initial mapping phase remains an exploring action whose length varies by a few scans; the pre-probe gate measures and reports that residual variation instead of assuming it away
the verdict is therefore non-perturbation of the measured outcome distribution, not bit-level determinism
decision.primary_method: N0-B matched same-seed episodes with alternating arm order
reasons: a faithful replay harness requires a new mapper-only launch path, a TF re-publisher, a service-call scheduler and a determinism argument for the threaded matcher (facts F1-F4); that is a multi-day change to the ROS/Stage pipeline
the instrument being tested is blocking file I/O inside the mapper answer path (fact F5), so replaying recorded messages cannot reproduce the very mechanism whose effect is in question
matched same-seed pairs remove the actual defect of the earlier comparison (the TSP seed differed between the OFF and ON episodes), which is the confound the decision needs to remove
required_inputs_recorded: karto_in localized scans (topic stream with timestamps)
